data.api-enricher-kaspragent-agent.yaml:
agents:
- description: 'Enriches user events by calling external APIs to gather additional
    information

    such as geolocation data and user details. Implements caching to minimize API
    calls.

    '
  input:
    channel: null
    declare: null
    take: null
    topic:
      compacting: null
      config: null
      deleting: null
      key_serializer: null
      name: enriched-user-events
      partitions: null
      pattern: null
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_serializer: null
  isolated_partitions: null
  name: api-enricher-kaspragent
  noack: null
  output:
    topics:
    - ack: null
      compacting: null
      config: null
      declare: false
      deleting: null
      headers_selector: null
      key_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_key(value):\n    return value[\"user_id\"]\n"
      key_serializer: null
      name: api-enriched-events
      name_selector: null
      partition_selector: null
      partitions: null
      pass_through: false
      predicate:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def should_send(value):\n    return value.get(\"enrichment_successful\"\
          , False)\n"
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_value(value):\n    return value[\"enriched_event\"]\n"
      value_serializer: null
    - ack: null
      compacting: null
      config: null
      declare: false
      deleting: null
      headers_selector: null
      key_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_key(value):\n    return value[\"user_id\"]\n"
      key_serializer: null
      name: api-enrichment-errors
      name_selector: null
      partition_selector: null
      partitions: null
      pass_through: false
      predicate:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def should_send(value):\n    return not value.get(\"enrichment_successful\"\
          , True)\n"
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_value(value):\n    return value[\"error_info\"]\n"
      value_serializer: null
  processors:
    init:
      entrypoint: null
      python: "import aiohttp\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport os\nfrom datetime\
        \ import datetime, timezone, timedelta\nimport hashlib\n\napp = context[\"\
        app\"]\n\n# Configuration\nGEO_API_URL = os.getenv(\"GEO_API_URL\", \"http://ip-api.com/json\"\
        )\nUSER_API_URL = os.getenv(\"USER_API_URL\", \"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users\"\
        )\nAPI_TIMEOUT = int(os.getenv(\"API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\", \"5\"))\nCACHE_TTL_HOURS\
        \ = int(os.getenv(\"CACHE_TTL_HOURS\", \"24\"))\n\n# Create a single HTTP\
        \ session for reuse across all API calls\n# This session will be reused for\
        \ all HTTP requests to improve performance\nhttp_session = aiohttp.ClientSession(\n\
        \    timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=API_TIMEOUT)\n)\n\n# Note: In a production\
        \ environment, you may want to handle session cleanup\n# when the agent shuts\
        \ down, though Kaspr typically handles this automatically\n\nasync def make_api_call(session,\
        \ url, params=None):\n    \"\"\"Make an HTTP API call with timeout and error\
        \ handling.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        async with session.get(url, params=params)\
        \ as response:\n            if response.status == 200:\n                return\
        \ await response.json()\n            else:\n                return {\"error\"\
        : f\"HTTP {response.status}\"}\n    except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n       \
        \ return {\"error\": \"API timeout\"}\n    except Exception as e:\n      \
        \  return {\"error\": str(e)}\n\ndef is_cache_valid(cached_item):\n    \"\"\
        \"Check if a cached item is still valid based on TTL.\"\"\"\n    if not cached_item\
        \ or \"cached_at\" not in cached_item:\n        return False\n    \n    cached_at\
        \ = datetime.fromisoformat(cached_item[\"cached_at\"])\n    expiry = cached_at\
        \ + timedelta(hours=CACHE_TTL_HOURS)\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)\
        \ < expiry\n\ndef get_cache_key(api_type, identifier):\n    \"\"\"Generate\
        \ a consistent cache key.\"\"\"\n    return f\"{api_type}:{hashlib.md5(str(identifier).encode()).hexdigest()}\"\
        \n    \n"
    operations:
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: check_cache
        python: "def check_cache(value, cache):\n    \"\"\"\n    Check if we have\
          \ valid cached data for this event's enrichment needs.\n    \"\"\"\n   \
          \ ip_address = value.get(\"ip_address\")\n    user_id = value[\"user_id\"\
          ]\n    \n    # Check geo cache\n    geo_data = None\n    if ip_address:\n\
          \        geo_cache_key = get_cache_key(\"geo\", ip_address)\n        cached_geo\
          \ = cache.get(geo_cache_key)\n        if is_cache_valid(cached_geo):\n \
          \           geo_data = cached_geo[\"data\"]\n    \n    # Check user data\
          \ cache\n    user_data = None\n    user_cache_key = get_cache_key(\"user\"\
          , user_id)\n    cached_user = cache.get(user_cache_key)\n    if is_cache_valid(cached_user):\n\
          \        user_data = cached_user[\"data\"]\n    \n    return {\n       \
          \ **value,\n        \"cached_geo_data\": geo_data,\n        \"cached_user_data\"\
          : user_data,\n        \"needs_geo_api\": ip_address and not geo_data,\n\
          \        \"needs_user_api\": not user_data,\n        \"geo_cache_key\":\
          \ get_cache_key(\"geo\", ip_address) if ip_address else None,\n        \"\
          user_cache_key\": user_cache_key\n    }\n    \n"
      name: check-cache
      tables:
      - name: api-cache
        param_name: cache
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: enrich_with_geo_api
        python: "async def enrich_with_geo_api(value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Call geolocation\
          \ API to enrich event with location data.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not value.get(\"\
          needs_geo_api\"):\n        return {**value, \"api_geo_data\": value.get(\"\
          cached_geo_data\")}\n    \n    ip_address = value.get(\"ip_address\")\n\
          \    if not ip_address:\n        return {**value, \"api_geo_data\": None}\n\
          \    \n    geo_url = f\"{GEO_API_URL}/{ip_address}\"\n    geo_response =\
          \ await make_api_call(http_session, geo_url)\n        \n        if \"error\"\
          \ in geo_response:\n            app.log.warning(f\"Geo API error for IP\
          \ {ip_address}: {geo_response['error']}\")\n            return {**value,\
          \ \"api_geo_data\": None, \"geo_api_error\": geo_response[\"error\"]}\n\
          \        \n        # Extract relevant geo data\n        geo_data = {\n \
          \           \"country\": geo_response.get(\"country\"),\n            \"\
          country_code\": geo_response.get(\"countryCode\"),\n            \"region\"\
          : geo_response.get(\"regionName\"),\n            \"city\": geo_response.get(\"\
          city\"),\n            \"timezone\": geo_response.get(\"timezone\"),\n  \
          \          \"latitude\": geo_response.get(\"lat\"),\n            \"longitude\"\
          : geo_response.get(\"lon\"),\n            \"isp\": geo_response.get(\"isp\"\
          )\n        }\n        \n        return {**value, \"api_geo_data\": geo_data}\n\
          \        \n"
      name: enrich-with-geo-api
      tables: []
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: enrich_with_user_api
        python: "async def enrich_with_user_api(value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Call user\
          \ API to enrich event with user profile data.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not value.get(\"\
          needs_user_api\"):\n        return {**value, \"api_user_data\": value.get(\"\
          cached_user_data\")}\n    \n    user_id = value[\"user_id\"]\n    \n   \
          \ # Simulate user lookup - in real world, this would be your user service\n\
          \    user_url = f\"{USER_API_URL}/{hash(user_id) % 10 + 1}\"  # Map to user\
          \ 1-10\n    user_response = await make_api_call(http_session, user_url)\n\
          \        \n        if \"error\" in user_response:\n            app.log.warning(f\"\
          User API error for user {user_id}: {user_response['error']}\")\n       \
          \     return {**value, \"api_user_data\": None, \"user_api_error\": user_response[\"\
          error\"]}\n        \n        # Extract relevant user data\n        user_data\
          \ = {\n            \"name\": user_response.get(\"name\"),\n            \"\
          username\": user_response.get(\"username\"),\n            \"email\": user_response.get(\"\
          email\"),\n            \"phone\": user_response.get(\"phone\"),\n      \
          \      \"website\": user_response.get(\"website\"),\n            \"company\"\
          : user_response.get(\"company\", {}).get(\"name\"),\n            \"address\"\
          : {\n                \"city\": user_response.get(\"address\", {}).get(\"\
          city\"),\n                \"zipcode\": user_response.get(\"address\", {}).get(\"\
          zipcode\")\n            }\n        }\n        \n        return {**value,\
          \ \"api_user_data\": user_data}\n        \n"
      name: enrich-with-user-api
      tables: []
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: update_cache
        python: "def update_cache(value, cache):\n    \"\"\"\n    Update cache with\
          \ new API responses.\n    \"\"\"\n    current_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n\
          \    \n    # Cache geo data if we fetched it\n    if value.get(\"needs_geo_api\"\
          ) and value.get(\"api_geo_data\"):\n        geo_cache_key = value[\"geo_cache_key\"\
          ]\n        cache[geo_cache_key] = {\n            \"data\": value[\"api_geo_data\"\
          ],\n            \"cached_at\": current_time,\n            \"cache_type\"\
          : \"geo\"\n        }\n    \n    # Cache user data if we fetched it\n   \
          \ if value.get(\"needs_user_api\") and value.get(\"api_user_data\"):\n \
          \       user_cache_key = value[\"user_cache_key\"]\n        cache[user_cache_key]\
          \ = {\n            \"data\": value[\"api_user_data\"],\n            \"cached_at\"\
          : current_time,\n            \"cache_type\": \"user\"\n        }\n    \n\
          \    return value\n    \n"
      name: update-cache
      tables:
      - name: api-cache
        param_name: cache
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: compile_enrichment
        python: "def compile_enrichment(value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compile all enrichment\
          \ data into the final enriched event.\n    \"\"\"\n    enriched_event =\
          \ {**value}\n    \n    # Add geo enrichment\n    geo_data = value.get(\"\
          api_geo_data\")\n    if geo_data:\n        enriched_event.update({\n   \
          \         \"geo_country\": geo_data.get(\"country\"),\n            \"geo_country_code\"\
          : geo_data.get(\"country_code\"),\n            \"geo_region\": geo_data.get(\"\
          region\"),\n            \"geo_city\": geo_data.get(\"city\"),\n        \
          \    \"geo_timezone\": geo_data.get(\"timezone\"),\n            \"geo_coordinates\"\
          : [geo_data.get(\"latitude\"), geo_data.get(\"longitude\")] if geo_data.get(\"\
          latitude\") else None,\n            \"geo_isp\": geo_data.get(\"isp\")\n\
          \        })\n    \n    # Add user enrichment\n    user_data = value.get(\"\
          api_user_data\")\n    if user_data:\n        enriched_event.update({\n \
          \           \"user_name\": user_data.get(\"name\"),\n            \"user_username\"\
          : user_data.get(\"username\"),\n            \"user_email\": user_data.get(\"\
          email\"),\n            \"user_phone\": user_data.get(\"phone\"),\n     \
          \       \"user_company\": user_data.get(\"company\"),\n            \"user_city\"\
          : user_data.get(\"address\", {}).get(\"city\"),\n            \"user_zipcode\"\
          : user_data.get(\"address\", {}).get(\"zipcode\")\n        })\n    \n  \
          \  # Track enrichment success\n    has_errors = bool(value.get(\"geo_api_error\"\
          ) or value.get(\"user_api_error\"))\n    enrichment_successful = not has_errors\n\
          \    \n    result = {\n        **value,\n        \"enriched_event\": enriched_event,\n\
          \        \"enrichment_successful\": enrichment_successful,\n        \"enrichment_timestamp\"\
          : datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n    }\n    \n    if has_errors:\n\
          \        result[\"error_info\"] = {\n            \"user_id\": value[\"user_id\"\
          ],\n            \"geo_error\": value.get(\"geo_api_error\"),\n         \
          \   \"user_error\": value.get(\"user_api_error\"),\n            \"timestamp\"\
          : result[\"enrichment_timestamp\"]\n        }\n    \n    return result"
      name: compile-enrichment
      tables: []
      topic_send: null
    pipeline:
    - check-cache
    - enrich-with-geo-api
    - enrich-with-user-api
    - update-cache
    - compile-enrichment

data.counter-processor-kaspragent-agent.yaml:
agents:
- description: 'Processes enriched user events and maintains real-time counters for
    various dimensions.

    Performs lookups against user profiles for additional enrichment.

    '
  input:
    channel: null
    declare: null
    take: null
    topic:
      compacting: null
      config: null
      deleting: null
      key_serializer: null
      name: enriched-user-events
      partitions: null
      pattern: null
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_serializer: null
  isolated_partitions: null
  name: counter-processor-kaspragent
  noack: null
  output:
    topics:
    - ack: null
      compacting: null
      config: null
      declare: false
      deleting: null
      headers_selector: null
      key_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_key(value):\n    return f\"metrics:{value['dimension']}:{value['time_window']}\"\
          \n"
      key_serializer: null
      name: real-time-metrics
      name_selector: null
      partition_selector: null
      partitions: null
      pass_through: false
      predicate: null
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_value(value):\n    return value[\"metrics\"]\n"
      value_serializer: null
    - ack: null
      compacting: null
      config: null
      declare: false
      deleting: null
      headers_selector: null
      key_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_key(value):\n    return value[\"user_id\"]\n"
      key_serializer: null
      name: user-segments-updated
      name_selector: null
      partition_selector: null
      partitions: null
      pass_through: false
      predicate:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def should_send(value):\n    return \"segment_data\" in value\n"
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_value(value):\n    return value[\"segment_data\"]\n"
      value_serializer: null
  processors:
    init:
      entrypoint: null
      python: "from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta\nfrom collections\
        \ import defaultdict\nimport os\nimport math\n\napp = context[\"app\"]\n\n\
        # Configuration from environment\nWINDOW_SIZE_MINUTES = int(os.getenv(\"WINDOW_SIZE_MINUTES\"\
        , \"5\"))\nMAX_COUNTERS_PER_KEY = int(os.getenv(\"MAX_COUNTERS_PER_KEY\",\
        \ \"1000\"))\n\ndef get_time_window(timestamp, window_minutes=WINDOW_SIZE_MINUTES):\n\
        \    \"\"\"Get the time window bucket for a timestamp.\"\"\"\n    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp,\
        \ tz=timezone.utc)\n    # Round down to the nearest window_minutes interval\n\
        \    minutes = (dt.minute // window_minutes) * window_minutes\n    window_start\
        \ = dt.replace(minute=minutes, second=0, microsecond=0)\n    return window_start.isoformat()\n\
        \ndef calculate_user_segment(profile, recent_activity):\n    \"\"\"Calculate\
        \ user segment based on profile and recent activity.\"\"\"\n    # Simple segmentation\
        \ logic\n    total_events = profile.get(\"total_events\", 0)\n    days_since_signup\
        \ = profile.get(\"days_since_signup\", 0)\n    avg_daily_events = total_events\
        \ / max(days_since_signup, 1)\n    \n    recent_purchases = recent_activity.get(\"\
        purchase_count\", 0)\n    recent_logins = recent_activity.get(\"login_count\"\
        , 0)\n    \n    if recent_purchases >= 2:\n        return \"high_value\"\n\
        \    elif recent_logins >= 5 and avg_daily_events > 10:\n        return \"\
        active_user\"\n    elif days_since_signup <= 7:\n        return \"new_user\"\
        \n    elif recent_logins == 0:\n        return \"dormant\"\n    else:\n  \
        \      return \"regular_user\"\n        \n"
    operations:
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: lookup_profile
        python: "def lookup_profile(value, profiles):\n    \"\"\"\n    Looks up user\
          \ profile information and adds it to the event.\n    \"\"\"\n    user_id\
          \ = value[\"user_id\"]\n    profile = profiles.get(user_id, {\n        \"\
          user_id\": user_id,\n        \"total_events\": 0,\n        \"first_seen\"\
          : value[\"timestamp\"],\n        \"signup_date\": value.get(\"event_date\"\
          ),\n        \"country\": value.get(\"country_name\", \"Unknown\"),\n   \
          \     \"segments\": []\n    })\n    \n    # Calculate days since signup\n\
          \    if profile.get(\"signup_date\"):\n        signup_date = datetime.fromisoformat(profile[\"\
          signup_date\"])\n        current_date = datetime.fromisoformat(value[\"\
          event_date\"])\n        days_since_signup = (current_date - signup_date).days\n\
          \        profile[\"days_since_signup\"] = days_since_signup\n    \n    return\
          \ {\n        **value,\n        \"user_profile\": profile\n    }\n    \n"
      name: lookup-user-profile
      tables:
      - name: user-profiles
        param_name: profiles
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: update_counters
        python: "def update_counters(value, counters):\n    \"\"\"\n    Updates various\
          \ dimensional counters based on the event.\n    \"\"\"\n    timestamp =\
          \ float(value[\"timestamp\"])\n    time_window = get_time_window(timestamp)\n\
          \    event_type = value[\"event_type\"]\n    country = value.get(\"country_name\"\
          , \"Unknown\")\n    user_id = value[\"user_id\"]\n    \n    # Define dimensions\
          \ to count\n    dimensions = [\n        f\"global:total:{time_window}\"\
          ,\n        f\"event_type:{event_type}:{time_window}\",\n        f\"country:{country}:{time_window}\"\
          ,\n        f\"hour:{value['event_hour']}:{time_window}\",\n        f\"weekend:{value['is_weekend']}:{time_window}\"\
          \n    ]\n    \n    updated_counters = []\n    \n    for dimension in dimensions:\n\
          \        counter = counters.get(dimension, {\n            \"count\": 0,\n\
          \            \"unique_users\": set(),\n            \"first_event\": timestamp,\n\
          \            \"last_event\": timestamp,\n            \"dimension\": dimension,\n\
          \            \"time_window\": time_window\n        })\n        \n      \
          \  # Update counter\n        counter[\"count\"] += 1\n        counter[\"\
          unique_users\"].add(user_id)\n        counter[\"last_event\"] = max(counter[\"\
          last_event\"], timestamp)\n        \n        # Convert set to list for serialization,\
          \ keep only count\n        serializable_counter = {\n            **counter,\n\
          \            \"unique_user_count\": len(counter[\"unique_users\"])\n   \
          \     }\n        del serializable_counter[\"unique_users\"]\n        \n\
          \        counters[dimension] = counter  # Keep set in table\n        updated_counters.append(serializable_counter)\n\
          \    \n    return {\n        **value,\n        \"updated_counters\": updated_counters,\n\
          \        \"time_window\": time_window\n    }\n    \n"
      name: update-counters
      tables:
      - name: event-counters
        param_name: counters
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: calculate_segments
        python: "def calculate_segments(value, profiles, counters):\n    \"\"\"\n\
          \    Updates user segments based on recent activity patterns.\n    \"\"\"\
          \n    user_id = value[\"user_id\"]\n    profile = value[\"user_profile\"\
          ]\n    time_window = value[\"time_window\"]\n    \n    # Get recent activity\
          \ from counters\n    recent_activity = {}\n    for event_type in [\"login\"\
          , \"purchase\", \"page_view\"]:\n        counter_key = f\"user:{user_id}:event_type:{event_type}:{time_window}\"\
          \n        counter = counters.get(counter_key, {\"count\": 0})\n        recent_activity[f\"\
          {event_type}_count\"] = counter[\"count\"]\n    \n    # Calculate new segment\n\
          \    new_segment = calculate_user_segment(profile, recent_activity)\n  \
          \  \n    # Update profile\n    updated_profile = {\n        **profile,\n\
          \        \"total_events\": profile[\"total_events\"] + 1,\n        \"last_seen\"\
          : value[\"timestamp\"],\n        \"current_segment\": new_segment,\n   \
          \     \"last_updated\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n    }\n\
          \    \n    # Add to segments history if segment changed\n    if profile.get(\"\
          current_segment\") != new_segment:\n        segments = profile.get(\"segments\"\
          , [])\n        segments.append({\n            \"segment\": new_segment,\n\
          \            \"timestamp\": value[\"timestamp\"],\n            \"trigger_event\"\
          : value[\"event_type\"]\n        })\n        # Keep only last 10 segments\n\
          \        updated_profile[\"segments\"] = segments[-10:]\n    \n    profiles[user_id]\
          \ = updated_profile\n    \n    result = {**value}\n    if profile.get(\"\
          current_segment\") != new_segment:\n        result[\"segment_data\"] = {\n\
          \            \"user_id\": user_id,\n            \"old_segment\": profile.get(\"\
          current_segment\"),\n            \"new_segment\": new_segment,\n       \
          \     \"change_timestamp\": value[\"timestamp\"]\n        }\n    \n    return\
          \ result\n    \n"
      name: calculate-segments
      tables:
      - name: user-profiles
        param_name: profiles
      - name: event-counters
        param_name: counters
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: emit_metrics
        python: "def emit_metrics(value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Emits metrics for each\
          \ updated counter.\n    \"\"\"\n    for counter in value[\"updated_counters\"\
          ]:\n        yield {\n            \"dimension\": counter[\"dimension\"],\n\
          \            \"time_window\": counter[\"time_window\"],\n            \"\
          metrics\": counter\n        }"
      name: emit-metrics
      tables: []
      topic_send: null
    pipeline:
    - lookup-user-profile
    - update-counters
    - calculate-segments
    - emit-metrics
